exposure: Women with a CD4 count below 350 x 10^6 cells/L
Maternal CD4 count (<350 x 10^6 cells/L vs. no HIV)
cohort: 936 women planning to undergo vaginal delivery at Kalafong Hospital, South Africa, between March 3 and November 12, 2014.
finding: There were no significant differences in umbilical artery lactate levels or perinatal outcomes between women with and without HIV infection.
mod_finding: No difference in mode of delivery between participants with and without HIV infections (P=0.354).
